note: G04 transforms: two offsets, offset(log(exposure)) and offset(2 * off), one of them an expression: brms adds them into one offsets vector, exactly log(exposure) + 2 off of the data, in the Poisson's log-linear predictor, on the fitted and the new rows. brms's posterior_linpred on the fitted and new rows equals b_Intercept + X b + r_g (+ offsets) built from the columns described, to 2e-15 at every frozen point. Data: tier_g1, seed 2211, 36 rows.

brms.formula: cnt ~ x + offset(log(exposure)) + offset(2 * off) + (1 | g)
